answers.sql: SELECT 100.0*((SELECT SUM(amount_units) FROM observations WHERE period='P2')-(SELECT SUM(amount_units) FROM observations WHERE period='P1'))/(SELECT SUM(amount_units) FROM observations WHERE period='P1') AS value

WITH matched_keys AS (SELECT network_asset FROM observations GROUP BY network_asset HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT period)=2), totals AS (SELECT period,SUM(o.amount_units) AS amount FROM observations AS o JOIN matched_keys AS m USING(network_asset) GROUP BY period) SELECT 100.0*((SELECT amount FROM totals WHERE period='P2')-(SELECT amount FROM totals WHERE period='P1'))/(SELECT amount FROM totals WHERE period='P1') AS value
